questions: Should every member pay the same fixed amount each round, or can each payment be any amount above zero?
Can a member make more than one payment in the same round, for example paying in parts, or only one payment per round?
Can any member of the group collect a round's pot, or only someone who has paid into that round?
answers: No, record whatever each member actually paid; the pot is the total paid in for that round.
Yes, sometimes people pay in two parts; all of it counts toward that round.
